value.title: La Maldición
value.synopsis: Martin and Lucas are getting used to living in the boarding school. Fermin is looking for Irene's baby. Hector has decided to sell one of the diamonds he found in the cave. Lucas makes friends with Paula and Evelyn.

value.title: La Sala del Tesoro
value.synopsis: As Saúl appears abruptly before Marcos to advise him towards identify the bodies in the morgue as his parents, Fermin discovers a treasure trove in the labyrinth, and Elsa cares for Baby Samuel in secret.

value.title: El Secreto Mejor Guardado
value.synopsis: Marcos, Lucas and Héctor consider sharing their best kept secrets (which would all be best if kept secret).

value.title: Premonición
value.synopsis: With the threat of death looming as he continues to pursue information about his missing mother, Marcos takes an extreme course of action to make a hospital connection that won't arouse suspicion.

value.title: El Exorcismo
value.synopsis: Miguel convinces Paula and Lucas that Evelyn's sleepwalking comes from demonic possession. He highly recommends an exorcism in which water balloons figure predominantly.

value.title: Escrito en las Estrellas
value.synopsis: Lieutenant Jimeno visits the school to investigate the death of Mateo Tabuenca, whose decaying corpse policemen found in the trunk of a teacher's car.

value.title: Un Gran Soldado
value.synopsis: As the school remains a hot focal point of multiple mysteries and intrigue, Iván signs the papers acknowledging Jacques as his father, almost immediately aware of its depths as a bad move.

value.title: La Llave
value.synopsis: As more connections come to light between those at the school, Elsa awaits word on baby Samuel while Paula and Eveyln strive to prevent Jacinta's death.

value.title: El Unicornio
value.synopsis: Martín hopes the incredible nature of Lucas's latest prophetic dream (where Camilo collides with a flying unicorn) will prove them all insubstantial. Meanwhile, Julia sets out for her father's safety deposit box alone.

value.title: Un Punto en el Mar
value.synopsis: As the kids try again to undermine the murder dream, the gang deciphers the last book clue, the school elects a new principal, Julia leaves for good with her step-father, and Fermín's search for his father's killer pays off.

value.title: La Noche de las Dos Lunas
value.synopsis: As the school celebrates its Night of the Twin Moons, several people put themselves in harm's way for the sake of another, and an unwary child playing sheriff roams the halls with a real gun.
